title: SKI — Talk to your AI coding agent. Hear it answer.
excerpt: A voice for your AI coding assistant — free forever on Mac and Windows, fully private, works offline. Speak, and hear it answer.
content_html:
Voice coding for your agent

Let your coding agent
talk with you.

You talk. It builds. It answers — out loud, in a natural voice. Everything runs on your own computer; nothing you say ever leaves it. Free for life.

100%

On-device

0

Bytes uploaded

∞

Recording retention

6+

Agents supported

01 · How it works

One install. Your coding agent listens
and talks with you

From installer to conversation in under two minutes.

01

Install SKI

One installer — DMG on Mac, EXE on Windows. The setup wizard sets your mic, voice, and hotkey in a few steps — no credit card.

02

Connect your agent

One click per agent — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw. A small skill your agent already understands: it hears you and answers.

03

Just talk

Say what you need out loud. The floating pill shows it heard you, your agent gets to work, and it answers out loud in a natural voice.

02 · The loop

Not dictation. A conversation.

Dictation tools stop at text-in. SKI closes the loop: replies are synthesized locally and spoken aloud — and full-duplex echo cancellation means you can interrupt it mid-sentence and be heard.

FULL-DUPLEXBARGE-INALL LOCAL

Live · see it in action

Watch SKI build a page — by voice.

Say what you want; your agent writes the code and it appears live. Here's a recipe page, start to finish — no hands.

03 · Private by design

Your voice never leaves your machine.

Sealed on your machine — inspectable, deletable, never uploaded.

A / Local models

Hears and speaks on your machine

Speech recognition and a natural neural voice, both running on-device. No audio is ever uploaded — there is nothing to upload it to.

B / Nothing hidden

No daemon, no cloud

The widget and your agent talk through plain files inside your own project. Inspect every byte; delete them any time.

C / You approve

Approve-before-send

Optional review mode: every transcript lands in an editable bubble first. Nothing reaches the agent until you hit ✓.

Now in the notch

It lives in your notch.

On Mac, SKI docks into the notch — black, flush with the menu bar, always in the same place; on a Mac without a physical notch it draws its own. On Windows it floats as a pill wherever you park it. Either way it rests as a quiet bar, then springs down into the full loop when there’s something to say.

04 · Features

Built for the way developers talk.

Every detail tuned for a real back-and-forth voice loop.

100%

On-device, all of it

Speech-to-text and the voice both run on your own machine. Nothing you say ever leaves it.

Hears & speaks locally

Local speech in, a natural neural voice out — no cloud, works offline.

Live agent status

A green dot shows your agent is actually listening — real-time, not polled.

Full-duplex barge-in

Talk over the agent and still be heard cleanly on open speakers — no push-to-talk. It knows when you're done and sends the thought whole.

A voice per project

Bind several repos at once; each answers in its own voice and routes to whichever one you're addressing.

recipesweb-appapi-gateway

Screenshots on demand

Hit the hotkey to grab your screen — it rides along with your next spoken request. Your agent can grab one itself, too, when it needs to see what you see.

Calendar auto-join

Connect Google Calendar and SKI sends your agent — participant or silent notetaker — into a meeting or recurring series, right on time. The meeting's project just has to be connected and active.

Offline meeting recorder

Record any meeting right on your machine — your mic plus the room audio — unlimited, no bot in the call, nothing uploaded.

Two ways into the room.

Record locally

Local meeting transcriber

Capture mic + system audio from Zoom, Meet, or Teams — transcribed on-device with speaker-tagged tracks.

  • Unlimited recording time and retention
  • Zero cloud — audio never leaves the machine
  • Live transcript while the meeting runs
  • Export to Markdown or plain text

Send your agent

Your agent, in the meeting

Paste a meeting URL into the widget and your coding agent joins the call as a live participant — speaking, listening, presenting.

  • Agentic or notetaker — talks and helps, or silently takes notes
  • Speaker-diarized transcript — tagged by who said what
  • Sees the screen, screenshares, reads & sends chat
  • Google Meet, Teams, Zoom — or create one from the widget

07 · FAQ

Plain answers to plain questions.

What is SKI?

A small floating app for your Mac or PC that lets you talk out loud to your AI coding assistant — and hear it answer in a natural voice.

What's a "coding agent"?

An AI assistant developers run alongside their code — tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or Gemini CLI. It can read files, write code, run tests, and answer questions. SKI gives it ears and a voice.

How does SKI actually work?

You speak; SKI turns it into text on your machine and hands it to your coding agent. The agent does the work — reads files, writes code, runs tests — then sends its reply back to SKI, which speaks it aloud in a natural voice and shows it in the pill or notch. A full spoken round-trip, over plain files in your own project.

What is silent mode?

Silent mode keeps SKI listening and replying, but the agent's answers appear only as text in the pill or notch — not spoken aloud (handy in a quiet room or on a call). It's the mirror of mute: mute silences your mic going in; silent silences the agent's voice coming out.

Do I have to keep the mic on the whole time?

No — mute it any time and SKI stops listening and releases the mic. On Mac you can also use the globe / fn key: tap to mute or unmute, or hold it as push-to-talk (Mac only; opt-in, needs one macOS permission).

How is this different from other voice tools?

Most are speech-to-text dictation — they put your words in a box and stop. SKI is a two-way voice loop for coding agents: it answers out loud, and it shows you what your agent is doing. Different job.

Do I need an internet connection?

No. Listening, understanding, and speaking all happen on your own machine. The only feature that touches the internet is sending your agent into a video meeting — and that's optional.

Is my voice recorded or sent anywhere?

No. Your voice becomes text on your own machine and is never uploaded. There's no cloud service listening in — there is nothing to upload to.

How much does it cost?

Free forever on Mac and Windows — register once, no credit card. Voice features and the meeting transcriber are all included. You only pay if you want your agent to join video calls through AgentCall — per minute, with free hours included.

How does SKI record meetings?

Two ways. Record locally — free, unlimited, on-device: SKI captures your mic and the meeting audio on separate tracks and transcribes them on your machine; nobody joins the call and nothing is uploaded (no per-speaker diarization in this mode). Send your agent in via AgentCall (cloud): a bot joins as an agentic participant (talks, answers, screenshares, sees the screen, reads and sends chat) or a silent notetaker, with a speaker-diarized transcript, connected to your project — the one paid feature, billed per minute with free hours included.

Where do my transcripts and sessions live?

In a built-in Transcripts window that lists your meetings, your voice sessions, and your local recordings — view, edit, copy, export (Markdown or plain text), or delete, all on your machine.

What do I need to run it?

An Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or later) on macOS 14.4 (Sonoma) or newer, or a PC on Windows 11 or 10. English today; more languages planned.

Is it the same app on Mac and Windows?

Yes — same voice loop, same agents, same on-device privacy, free for life on both. On Mac it docks into the notch (even on Macs without a physical notch); on Windows the pill floats wherever you drop it. Linux is on the list.

Just ski it.

Free for life. Register once — no card — and the voice loop, the meeting transcriber, everything on-device is yours forever. You pay only if your agent joins calls through AgentCall.

Free for life · On-device · Register once · English v1

你说话。 它建立了。 它以自然的声音大声回答。 一切都在您自己的计算机上运行；你所说的一切都不会离开它。 终身免费。

支持代理

01 · 工作原理

一安装。 您的编码代理会倾听并与您交谈

从安装到对话只需不到两分钟。

01

安装滑雪板

一个安装程序 — Mac 上为 DMG，Windows 上为 EXE。 设置向导只需几个步骤即可设置您的麦克风、语音和热键 - 无需信用卡。

02

连接您的代理

每个代理一键点击 — Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini CLI、OpenClaw。 您的代理已经了解一项小技能：它会听到您的声音并做出回答。

03

只是说话

大声说出你需要什么。 漂浮的药丸表明它听到了您的声音，您的代理开始工作，并以自然的声音大声回答。

02·循环

不是听写。 一次谈话。

听写工具在文本输入时停止。 SKI 关闭了循环：回复在本地合成并大声朗读 - 全双工回声消除意味着您可以在句子中打断并让对方听到。

全双工驳接本地

现场·观看实际操作

观看 SKI 通过语音构建页面。

说出你想说的话；您的代理编写代码并且代码显示为实时状态。 这是一个食谱页面，从头到尾——没有手。

03 · 设计上的私密性

您的声音永远不会离开您的机器。

密封在您的机器上——可检查、可删除、从未上传。

B / 没有隐藏任何内容

没有守护进程，没有云

小部件和您的代理通过您自己的项目内的纯文件进行通信。 检查每个字节；随时删除它们。

可选的审阅模式：每个成绩单首先落在可编辑的气泡中。 在您点击 ✓ 之前，代理不会收到任何信息。

现在处于档次

它就在你的档次里。

07 · FAQ

对简单问题的简单回答。

What is SKI?

一款适用于 Mac 或 PC 的小型浮动应用程序，可让您与 AI 编码助手大声交谈，并听到它以自然的声音回答。

What's a "coding agent"?

AI 助理开发人员与他们的代码一起运行 - Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 或 Gemini CLI 等工具。 它可以读取文件、编写代码、运行测试和回答问题。 SKI 赋予它耳朵和声音。

How does SKI actually work?

你说话； SKI 在您的机器上将其转换为文本，并将其交给您的编码代理。 代理完成工作 - 读取文件、编写代码、运行测试 - 然后将其回复发送回 SKI，SKI 以自然的声音大声朗读并在药丸或缺口中显示它。 通过您自己项目中的纯文件进行完整的口头往返。

What is silent mode?

静音模式可以让 SKI 继续聆听和回复，但客服人员的答案仅以文本形式出现在平板电脑或缺口中，而不会大声说出（在安静的房间或通话时很方便）。 它是静音之镜：静音使您的麦克风静音；沉默让特工的声音安静了下来。

Do I have to keep the mic on the whole time?

不——随时静音，SKI 就会停止聆听并释放麦克风。 在 Mac 上，您还可以使用 Globe/Fn 键：点击以静音或取消静音，或按住它作为一键通（仅限 Mac；选择加入，需要一个 macOS 权限）。

How is this different from other voice tools?

大多数都是语音到文本的听写——他们把你的话放在一个盒子里然后停下来。 SKI 是用于编码代理的双向语音循环：它大声回答，并向您显示代理正在做什么。 不同的工作。

Do I need an internet connection?

不会。听力、理解和口语全部发生在您自己的机器上。 唯一涉及互联网的功能是让您的座席参加视频会议 - 这是可选的。

Is my voice recorded or sent anywhere?

不会。您的声音会在您自己的计算机上变成文本，并且永远不会上传。 没有云服务在监听——没有任何东西可以上传。

How much does it cost?

Mac 和 Windows 上永久免费 — 注册一次，无需信用卡。 语音功能和会议转录器都包括在内。 仅当您希望您的客服人员通过 AgentCall 加入视频通话时，您才需要付费 - 每分钟，包括免费时间。

How does SKI record meetings?

两种方式。 本地录制 - 免费、无限制、在设备上：SKI 在不同的轨道上捕获您的麦克风和会议音频，并将其转录到您的机器上；没有人加入通话，也没有上传任何内容（在此模式下不会对每个发言者进行分类）。 通过 AgentCall（云）发送您的座席：机器人作为代理参与者（谈话、回答、屏幕共享、查看屏幕、阅读和发送聊天）或无声记笔记者加入，并带有讲话者日记记录，连接到您的项目 — 这是一项付费功能，按分钟计费，包括免费时间。

Where do my transcripts and sessions live?

在列出您的会议、语音会话和本地录音的内置“脚本”窗口中 - 查看、编辑、复制、导出（Markdown 或纯文本）或删除，所有操作都在您的计算机上进行。

What do I need to run it?

运行 macOS 14.4 (Sonoma) 或更高版本的 Apple Silicon Mac（M1 或更高版本），或者运行 Windows 11 或 10 的 PC。 今天英语；计划更多语言。

Is it the same app on Mac and Windows?

是的 - 相同的语音循环、相同的代理、相同的设备上隐私，两者均终身免费。 在 Mac 上，它可以插入凹口（即使在没有物理凹口的 Mac 上）；在 Windows 上，无论你把它扔到哪里，药丸都会漂浮起来。 Linux 就在名单上。
